title: htmldoc.space · Share HTML or Markdown files. Instantly.
excerpt: Share one HTML or Markdown file as an unlisted link that lives 30 days. Ask your AI agent, or run one command. No deploy.
content_html:
unlisted links · free · agent-ready

Ask your AI agent, or run one command. That's it.

By signing in you agree to the terms.

option 1 — run a command 
npx htmldoc-cli loginnpx htmldoc-cli report.htmlhttps://p.htmldoc.space/abc123def456
option 2 — ask your AI agent 
npx skills add ajaxray/htmldoc-skillshare this plan with htmldochttps://p.htmldoc.space/abc123def456

And yes, you can just upload or paste a file from your dashboard.

Small by design. Sensible by default.

01Unlisted, not indexed

Twelve-character ids, noindex, no listing. Anyone with the link can open it.

02Lives 30 days

Every upload resets the clock. Re-share a file and the link stays the same. How updates work.

03HTML as-is, Markdown rendered

HTML is served byte for byte. Markdown becomes a clean readable page with GitHub-flavoured syntax.

Acceptable use

Single HTML or Markdown documents only. No phishing, malware, or illegal content. Links are unlisted, not private: anyone who has one can open it. Pages must not store secrets in browser storage, because the viewer origin is shared by every page. Pages expire 30 days after the last upload; re-upload to extend.

Data: we keep your GitHub id and login, nothing more. Seen something that should not be online? Report a page. Full terms.
